viper.lore: A knife-fast frigate for captains who share the spoils and settle betrayal up close.

bastion.lore: A shield-first destroyer built to hold one safe lane while Republic crews move civilians clear.

albatros.lore: A patched Reaver cruiser: never the best ship in the fight, but always the last one still charging.

mule.lore: A long-range hauler that carries rescue gear as readily as ore; the Authority never asks what a stranded crew needs twice.

tortoise.lore: Ironclad crews built this armored hauler so vital cargo can reach home through a shooting war.

monolith.lore: A Republic line battleship whose layered hull gives escort crews time to regroup behind its spine.

comet.lore: A Helion racer made to turn a clear route into a record; its light frame rewards speed over a fair duel.

kite.lore: A compact patrol frigate sold on one promise: help will find you before the route closes.

seraph.lore: The Authority sends Seraphs ahead of its convoys, where a bright beacon can matter as much as a gun.

bulldog.lore: A Reaver brawler with room for two cannons and no patience for a captain who breaks crew trust.

ironside.lore: Three patrol hulls became one Ironclad cruiser, reinforced wherever the miners said the first one failed.

tidewarden.lore: A Frontier picket watches the public lane and holds its mark until a rescue signal answers.

mantis.lore: A Republic strike cruiser that leaves formation only when a fast response can protect the whole patrol.

verdant.lore: Built to bridge escort and battleship duties, Verdant carries a Republic line forward without leaving it exposed.

imperator.lore: An Ironclad battleship made to hold ground long enough for settlement crews to evacuate behind its armor.

leviathan.lore: The Leviathan anchors a Republic defense line; its lance waits until every civilian convoy is clear.

spartan.tagline: Disciplined fleets; safe passage is a public duty.
spartan.panel: We defend civilian routes with coordinated formations, layered shields and visible command ships. Force is a public trust, measured by who makes it home.

reaver.tagline: Share the spoils. Never leave a crew behind.
reaver.panel: Captains earn authority by keeping a crew fed and a ship flying. Salvaged armor, close-range pressure and a hard code make betrayal costly.

kretari.tagline: One living signal can guide a whole migration.
kretari.panel: Living hulls carry brood chambers between safe worlds. Shared memory and the survival of the young shape every migration and answer to danger.

varn.tagline: Every risk priced. Every obligation recorded.
varn.panel: Predictable routes and enforceable contracts are our public good. Symmetrical command hulls protect the core while measured force keeps agreements intact.

ironclad.tagline: Repair what you can. Hold while neighbors escape.
ironclad.panel: Settlement crews build with replaceable armor, visible braces and parts a belt-side shop can repair. We hold ground until the evacuation is done.

helion.tagline: Keep routes open with dependable speed.
helion.panel: Our light, efficient hulls move people and cargo between markets. Shared standards and reliable engines turn each successful contract into the next open route.

warden.tagline: Rescue first. Keep the frontier routes public.
warden.panel: Rangers patrol beyond easy support, mark safe passages and answer distress calls. We cooperate on security while resisting tolls that close a public route.

independent.panel: Unaligned ships trade under local names and practical warranties. Expect civilian refits, salvaged hardware and a seller who values payment more than a flag.
